pathParams.name: id
pathParams.description: Replication Job ID. The ID is composed of a Guest ID and a job number, separated by a hyphen, i.e. '<GUEST>-<JOBNUM>'.

params.name: delete
params.description: A list of settings you want to delete.

params.name: digest
params.description: Prevent changes if current configuration file has a different digest. This can be used to prevent concurrent modifications.

params.name: rate
params.description: Rate limit in mbps (megabytes per second) as floating point number.

params.name: remove_job
params.description: Mark the replication job for removal. The job will remove all local replication snapshots. When set to 'full', it also tries to remove replicated volumes on the target. The job then removes itself from the configuration file.

params.name: schedule
params.description: Storage replication schedule. The format is a subset of `systemd` calendar events.

params.name: source
params.description: For internal use, to detect if the guest was stolen.
